    Right tau-data on a finite-dimensional module skeleton #

    Minimal right almost-split maps and their kernels give the chosen right mesh at each indecomposable label. Finite componentwise biproducts extend these meshes to every object and assemble the generic finite right-tau interface.

    The kernel--source--endpoint complex of the chosen minimal right almost-split morphism at a skeleton label.

      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Iyama.RightTauSequence (S.labelRightMesh y)

      Every label mesh is a right tau-sequence. At a nonprojective endpoint the terminal map is epic and its kernel inclusion is left almost split; at a projective endpoint the terminal map is monic and its kernel is zero.
